items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe over at the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very happy to have percussionist Victor Rendón with me.

ctx.x: Okay. Well thank you for your time today. I very much enjoyed it.
